q1.explanationZh: give sb. a hand 意为“助某人一臂之力；帮某人忙”，与 help sb. 意思相同。

q2.explanationZh: for free 意为“免费”，常放在句末：You can get it for free.

q3.explanationZh: encourage sb. to do sth. 意为“鼓励某人做某事”，to 后面用动词原形。

q4.explanationZh: from time to time 意为“不时；有时”，表示动作偶尔发生。

q5.explanationZh: go home 意为“回家”。home 是副词，前面不加 to。

q6.explanationZh: get into the habit of 意为“养成……的习惯”，of 后面接名词或动词 -ing 形式。

q7.explanationZh: for example 意为“例如”，位置灵活，常用逗号与其他部分隔开。

q8.explanationZh: do sb. a favour 意为“帮某人忙”，与 help sb. / give sb. a hand 意思相同。

q9.explanationZh: for the time being 意为“暂时；眼下”。

q10.explanationZh: do some shopping 意为“买东西”，与 go shopping 意思相近。

q11.explanationZh: give up 意为“放弃”，后面接名词或动词 -ing 形式，如 give up smoking。

q12.explanationZh: get along/on (with) 意为“与……相处；进展”，along 和 on 都可以用，如 get on well with sb.。

q13.explanationZh: dream of 意为“想到；梦想”，与 think of / think about 意思相同。

q14.explanationZh: focus on 意为“聚焦于；集中（精力）于”，也可以说 focus sth. on sth.。

q15.explanationZh: far away (from) 意为“（离……）遥远”，说明离某处时加 from。

q16.explanationZh: get on 意为“上车”，反义词组是 get off（下车）。

q17.explanationZh: for the first time 意为“第一次”，注意要有 the。

q18.explanationZh: get to 意为“到达”，后面接地点名词；接 home、there 等副词时不用 to。

q19.explanationZh: fill in 意为“填充；填写”，如 fill in the form（填表）。

q20.explanationZh: go for a swim 意为“去游泳”，与 go swimming 意思相同。

q21.explanationZh: fall asleep 意为“入睡；睡着”，asleep 是形容词。

q22.explanationZh: go sailing 意为“去航海；去航行”，“go + 动词 -ing”表示去做某项活动。

q23.explanationZh: go hiking 意为“去远足；去徒步旅行”，“go + 动词 -ing”表示去做某项活动。

q24.explanationZh: find out 意为“找出；查明；了解”，指经过调查、查找后弄清楚。

q25.explanationZh: get ready for 意为“为……作准备”，for 后面接名词。

q26.explanationZh: “互相；彼此”= each other，作 known 的宾语。

q27.explanationZh: “打扮”= dress up；句子讲的是已经发生的事（他们参加了新年晚会），dress 用过去式 dressed。

q28.explanationZh: “上车”= get on；when you 后面用一般现在时，get on 用原形。

q29.explanationZh: “摆脱”= get rid of；had better 后面接动词原形，所以用 get rid of。

q30.explanationZh: “第一次”= for the first time，放在句末。

q31.explanationZh: “向前走”= go ahead；and 连接两个祈使句动作，go 用原形。

q32.explanationZh: “助某人一臂之力”= give sb. a hand；句子讲过去（was lifting），give 用过去式 gave，sb. 换成 me。

q33.explanationZh: “下车”= get off；as soon as 引导的句子讲过去的事，get 用过去式 got。

q34.explanationZh: “起床”= get up；Yesterday morning 表示过去，get 用过去式 got。

q35.explanationZh: “对……感到厌倦”= get tired of；never 表示经常性情况，用一般现在时，of 后面接 watching。

q36.sampleAnswer: His dream of being a doctor has come true.
references: His dream of being a doctor has come true.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q36.explanationZh: “愿望”用 dream（名词），dream of being a doctor 表示“当医生的梦想”；“实现”= come true，用现在完成时 has come true。

q37.sampleAnswer: To build a good relationship, we should trust in each other.
references: To build a good relationship, we should trust in each other.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q37.explanationZh: “彼此信任”= trust (in) each other；“要建立……”用不定式 To build … 放在句首表示目的。

q38.sampleAnswer: We should get into the habit of keeping good hours.
references: We should get into the habit of keeping good hours.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q38.explanationZh: “养成……的习惯”= get into the habit of，of 后接动词 -ing；“早睡早起”= keep good hours。

q39.sampleAnswer: At the yesterday’s English Evening, all of us enjoyed ourselves.
references: At the yesterday’s English Evening, all of us enjoyed ourselves.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q39.explanationZh: “玩得很开心”= enjoy oneself；主语是 all of us，oneself 变成 ourselves，过去的事用 enjoyed。

q40.sampleAnswer: He helped us to fill in a big gap in our knowledge.
references: He helped us to fill in a big gap in our knowledge.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q40.explanationZh: “填补空白”= fill in a gap；“帮某人做某事”= help sb. (to) do sth.，过去的事用 helped。

q41.sampleAnswer: Our class teacher asked us if we had got ready for the final exams.
references: Our class teacher asked us if we had got ready for the final exams.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q41.explanationZh: “为……做好准备”= get ready for；“问我们是否……”用 asked us if …，从句用过去完成时 had got ready for。

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q42.explanationZh: “戒烟”= give up smoking，give up 后面接动词 -ing 形式；“应该”用 should。

q43.sampleAnswer: You can look up the dictionary and find out the meaning of the word.
references: You can look up the dictionary and find out the meaning of the word.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q43.explanationZh: “查词典”= look up the dictionary；“找出”= find out；两个动作用 and 连接。

q44.sampleAnswer: I’m sure you’ll get on well with your classmates if you are kind and friendly to them.
references: I’m sure you’ll get on well with your classmates if you are kind and friendly to them.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q44.explanationZh: “与……相处融洽”= get on well with；“如果……”用 if 引导条件句，主句 you’ll 表示将来。

q45.sampleAnswer: Our English teacher is kind and patient. She always encourages us to put up our hands in her class.
references: Our English teacher is kind and patient. She always encourages us to put up our hands in her class.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q45.explanationZh: “鼓励我们举手”= encourage us to put up our hands；“总是”用 always，主语 she 动词加 -s。
